conventions.notes: Yield placement: after_product_label from crops 02 and 03 (7e, 73%; [18O]-3a, 68%). Crop 04 puts the yield on a line under the bold label (X = Br, 91%, 45 min), so placement is not uniform across the four crops. Arrow length over bond length: crop 02 gives 410/37 px (11.1) and crop 04 gives 300/27 px (11.1); crop 01 gives 255/36 px (7.1) and crop 03 gives 230/39 px (5.9). The card keeps the 11.1 value of the two crops that agree; the spread is 5.9 to 11.1. Crop 04 is a web figure image of unknown print scale, so its ratio is approximate. abbreviate_groups null: no group is drawn as a label in two crops. Crop 02 draws OTMS, Me, Ph, CO2Me, CN and NO2 labels; crop 04 draws OMe; crop 02 mentions MeO only inside substituent names in the text. TMS-N3 in crops 02 and 03 is a reagent formula in running text, not a drawn label. Substrate colours: flat #800000 and #004080 fills in crop 02 (about 13,400 and 20,200 pixels) and the same blue cluster in crop 03; crop 01 colours the aryl reagent 2a in pure blue #0000FF instead and crop 04 has no substrate colouring. new_bond_color null: purple in crop 04 only; new bonds are black in crops 01 and 03. reagent_text_color #000000: reagent and condition text is black in all four crops; the blue-grey italic section headers in crops 02 and 03 and the single blue word ocean in crop 04 are annotations, not reagent text. conditions_split: catalyst or oxidant above the arrow and solvent, temperature and time below in all four crops; base sits below the arrow in crops 01 (DIPEA) and 04 (KOtBu).

reaction_scheme.notes: All four crops are reaction schemes. The values are the top-level conventions, so this section sets no override.
